sql:
SELECT
  SUM(order_count) AS order_count
  , SUM(valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
  , SUM(net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
FROM (
  SELECT
    store_id AS store
    , 1 AS order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS valid_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS net_sales_cents
  FROM "data"."main"."orders_enriched" orders_semantic_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_6
WHERE store in ('S01')
answer: 统计范围：青禾当前客户数据中，2026年8月按下单日期归属、订单成交门店编号为S01的订单，汇总不再分组。结果：创建订单数16笔（包含取消单，按订单号去重）；有效订单数13笔（paid且实付金额减退款金额大于零，取消和全退不计）；净销售额54,650分（即546.50元；paid订单实付减退款后合计，取消单不计）。本轮为合成测试数据。
